description: Get the debugger state: whether execution is paused, the pause reason, hit breakpoints and the full call stack. A pause is reported whatever caused it. `hitBreakpoints` lists only breakpoints set through this server, so it is empty at a breakpoint set in DevTools. Positions are 1-based, and source-mapped where the script has a source map. A source-mapped frame also gives `compiledUrl`/`compiledLine`/`compiledColumn`, its position in the loaded script.
name: get_debugger_state

callStack.description: Source-mapped positions when available. Present only when paused.

droppedBreakpoints.description: Breakpoints set by `source` whose file has changed since: removed, and reported here once.

hitBreakpoints.description: IDs of breakpoints hit. Present only when paused.

reason.description: Pause reason (e.g. "other" for a breakpoint, "step", "exception"). Present only when paused.
